description: This file defines the ProductListActivity class, which is an Android activity responsible for displaying a list of products in an e-commerce app. It handles user interactions such as search, filter, category selection via chips, loading product data with paging, managing cart interactions, saving/loading presets, and UI state updates including loading/error/empty states.

classes.name: ProductListActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing product display, filtering, categories, cart interactions, presets, and UI state transitions.

methods.name: ensureCartIdentityOrPrompt
methods.description: Verifies if the user has an active cart email; prompts for email if not.

methods.name: setupCategoryChipsAndGrouping
methods.description: Initializes category chips UI and handles their interactions, including rebuilding grouped sections.

methods.name: toggleGroupedMode
methods.description: Switches between grouped sections view and paginated list view based on category selection.

methods.name: renderCategoryChips
methods.description: Sets up and populates the category chips RecyclerView.

methods.name: rebuildGroupedSections
methods.description: Creates and renders category-based sections with lazy loading in the grouped view.

methods.name: maybeLoadSectionIfVisible
methods.description: Checks if a section is near the viewport and triggers loading of its preview items.

methods.name: loadSectionPreview
methods.description: Loads preview data for a category section when it becomes visible.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures subtle item animations for the product recycler view.

methods.name: setupPresetsAndClearAll
methods.description: Initializes controls for saving/loading presets and clearing all filters.

methods.name: setupSearchAndFilters
methods.description: Connects search bar and filter UI controls to the ViewModel state/actions.

methods.name: syncFilterControlsToState
methods.description: Updates UI controls to reflect the current filter and query state.

methods.name: renderActiveFilterChips
methods.description: Displays chips representing active filters and search queries, with removal options.

methods.name: showSavePresetDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to input and save a new preset.

methods.name: showPresetsDialog
methods.description: Displays existing presets for application or deletion.

methods.name: showPresetActionDialog
methods.description: Shows options (apply, delete) for a selected preset.

methods.name: confirmDeletePreset
methods.description: Asks for user confirmation before deleting a preset.

methods.name: updateEmptyStateText
methods.description: Sets empty view message based on current search/filter state.
